title: fix(fields): a numeric formula result reads as a number, and the datetime cell's text separates date and time (objectui#11683)
body:
Fixes #11683

Clause-②: no

Two cell renderers in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` drew text that read wrong. Both were found by the 2026-10-06 showcase dogfood (objectui#11672, items 10 and 16). Implemented by session `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8` (seat `domain:ui#3`, round 1).

## What changed

**Formula cell (`FormulaCellRenderer`).** It printed every result as raw monospace text, so Projects' Budget Remaining (a formula with no `returnType`) read `200000` beside a formatted currency column. A numeric result is now drawn by `NumberCellRenderer`, whose `formatNumberFieldValue` is the one call every number face makes. That gives the locale's grouping, and the width `resolveFieldScale` answers for the field. The spec applies `scale` to a `formula` field ("whose computed result is rounded to it"), so a declared `scale` is honoured. The formula cell's guard is unchanged.

Which results count as numbers:
- `returnType: 'number'`: the spec's declared value type, read as declared. A numeric string is read as a number here, as the number cell reads one.
- no `returnType`: the value's own JSON type, and only a JS number. A string of digits from an undeclared formula stays text, because nothing says it is a quantity.
- any other declared `returnType` (`text`, `boolean`, `date`): drawn exactly as before. A declaration is never overridden by the value.

`summary` is registered to the same renderer, so a numeric roll-up (it has no `returnType`) is drawn by the number cell too. Every face that dispatches through `getCellRenderer` changes with it: grid, record detail, related lists, cards, reports, dashboard record fields and the approvals summary card.

**Datetime cell (`DateTimeCellRenderer`).** On the compact face, which is the default, the date and the time were two spans separated by an `ml-2` margin alone. So the text a copy takes, a screen reader reads and `textContent` returns ran the halves together: `2026/10/6上午1:42` in zh-CN, `10/6/20261:42 am` in en-US. A text space now sits between the two spans. The cell's text is therefore exactly the string `formatDateTime(value, { style: 'compact' })` returns, because that function joins the same two halves with one space. The time span keeps its muted colour; its margin narrows from `ml-2` to `ml-1` beside the space, so the halves stay visibly apart. `packages/core/src/utils/date-display.ts` is not touched (PR objectui#11729 holds it).

No export, prop, language-pack key or spec key is added.

## The reading the card asked for: do the formula's inputs give a better type?

Not one this renderer may use. Read on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0:
- `FieldSchema.returnType` is `number | text | boolean | date`, with no currency value.
- The spec's field form gives `returnType` this help text: "Declared value type of the formula, stamped from the inferred CEL type. Consumers read it instead of re-parsing the expression."

Budget Remaining's expression subtracts two `currency` fields, so it IS money. But getting "currency" from that means parsing the CEL expression and type-checking it against the object's fields in the renderer. That is the re-parse the contract tells consumers not to do, and it would be a second inference engine beside the authoring one (`ObjectFieldInspector` stamps `returnType` from the inferred CEL type). So an untyped numeric formula renders as a grouped number, not as money. Showing it as money needs the spec to let a formula declare that, which is a decision for the spec and is left out of this PR (see Acceptance notes).

## Pins (en-US and zh-CN, measured on `textContent`)

New: `packages/fields/src/__tests__/formulaDatetimeCells.copiedText-11683.test.tsx`
- datetime: the cell's text equals `formatDateTime(INSTANT, { style: 'compact', locale })` and the literals `10/6/2026 1:42 am` / `2026/10/6 上午1:42`, and is not the run-together text; `format: 'short'` reaches the same face; the time span stays muted.
- formula: untyped `200000` reads `200,000` and equals the number cell's face for the same value; no monospace; de-DE reads `200.000` (en-US and zh-CN group alike, so this is the case that proves the locale reaches the formatter); a fraction keeps its natural precision; a `summary` roll-up `8900` reads `8,900`; `returnType: 'number'` (also over a numeric string) is the number face; a declared `scale: 2` reads `200,000.00`. Two controls stay text: a string of digits with no `returnType`, and `returnType: 'text'` over a number.

Updated (each pinned the run-together text as the expected face): `datetime-compact-style-7443.test.tsx` (the joined face now carries the space; the offset class pin reads `ml-1`), `datetimeCell.formatVocabulary-8853.test.tsx` (`compactCellText` joins with a space; `9/11/2026 9:30 am`), `datetime-carriers.impossibleDay-10301.test.tsx` (`2/28/2026 10:00 am`).

## Measured

The full runs are on `f2fa584`. The head is `a4a2375`, whose only change from `f2fa584` rewords one comment in `FormulaCellRenderer` (4 lines, all comment). On `a4a2375` the six formula/datetime pin files were re-run (`Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 191 passed (191)`: the new file, the three updated ones, `emptinessFloorExtensions-8496` and `cellRenderers.objectLiteral-8596`), the type-check was re-run (exit 0), and the light gates and eslint on `index.tsx` were re-run (each exit 0).

That is a declared narrowing: the rest of the farm is CI's. Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`; the seconds are shared-box seconds.

**Ablation** (through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which landed each mutation on disk and proved each restore: blob equals HEAD `86e762b7a312`, `git diff HEAD` empty), over the new pin file plus the three updated ones:
- the number arm disabled (anchor `if (returnType === 'number' || …` replaced by `if (false)`): `15 failed, 83 passed`. Exactly the 15 formula number cases went red; the two text controls and every datetime case stayed green.
- the old datetime markup restored (no text space, `ml-2`): `20 failed, 78 passed` across all 4 files. Every datetime text pin went red; every formula case stayed green.

## Acceptance notes

Read and left alone, outside this card's file surface (reported to the seat, not filed here):
- The read-only formula WIDGET (`widgets/FormulaField.tsx`, the form face) still prints `200000` (no `returnType`) and `200000.00` (`returnType: 'number'`, a `toFixed(2)`), monospace, in en-US and zh-CN, where the cell now reads `200,000`. Measured with a throwaway probe (never committed) on `f2fa584`. One stored value, two faces.
- The formula CELL still ignores a declared `returnType` of `boolean` or `date`: it prints `true` and `2026-07-04` in monospace, where the widget prints `Yes` and `Jul 4`. Same probe. Which date face a cell should use (the date cell's relative default or `formatDate`'s default) is not pinned anywhere, so it was not guessed here.
- Currency for a formula is not expressible in the spec's `returnType` today (see the reading above).
